checks.summary:
Final Opus review of claude/fix-round-8 (HEAD 7aba635) against 1bc48a0. I read the whole merged diff against decisions8.md, triage8.md and the earlier binding decisions. I ran the targeted backend tests on a throwaway database (opusrev8, now dropped): test_fix8_death, test_fix8_circle, test_fix8_restarts, test_00_startup and test_surface gave 127 passed and 1 failed. The failure is test_cors_allows_configured_origin_only, which fails only because my shell did not set CORS_ORIGINS. The frontend builds with vite. I made no edits and the working tree is clean.

Every item in scope does what decisions8 and the triage ask. Nothing decided earlier was removed or weakened:
- Round 6's held marks are still stored and resent, and #81 only lands a held mark first at a closed desk.
- The roll replay (send_held_roll) is unchanged, and activity_history now comes after it.
- The dead as a record is stronger: reports and revive are refused, and a report filed before the death keeps its card.
- decisions_fix4's release rules hold. Nothing goes up at a death, when a death is lifted, or at an approval, and End Assignment still resets the count and clears departed_spends.
- decisions_run4 holds: the felt keeps the roll after End Assignment, only the stamp goes.

On the server:
- scar_pending and let_in are columns, covered in both test_00_startup lists.
- The death lowers the pools in its own commit under the circle lock, then sends circle_update and one log line.
- departed_spends works across release, rejoin, approve and End Assignment. It is reserved, stripped from frames and refused from players.
- The revive refusal is 403. DEAD_REFUSED covers reports and circle.py checks again under the lock.
- The charter is refused before the seal, and the players' chapter house wins at the seal.
- spending_paused closes at End Assignment and reopens at the first dispatch. The toggle and both circle update messages lock the row, and players cannot write the flag.
- The +1 clamp keeps any carry-over.
- amended_at is kept and the store carries it (7aba635). A no-change amendment is refused with "Nothing changed."
- activity_history is sent on every connect.
- Non-Combatant points are resent on connect, and a full drive is refused.
- A roll is refused while a gilded die waits.
- The felt roll carries settled.
- WEBSOCKET.md, FAQ.md, QUIRKS.md, DESIGN.md and openapi.json (held_marks, let_in) are updated.

The seams between groups mostly line up:
- #76 is consistent between access.py and circle.py.
- spendRefusal in the store is shown by CircleView.
- Revive is refused by the server and gone from the player's sheet.
- endpoint.py's let_in block sits before the connect frames and activity_history is last.
- The two edits to tests/support.py merged cleanly.

The real seam problems are on the player's Circle page. The resources "i" now says that End Assignment closes spending twice, and an old spend refusal comes back each time the Circle tab is opened.

All 56 choices fit decisions8. Robert should be asked about these:
- (1) An investigator outside any campaign can now never be revived.
- (2) 88.u11: spending reopens on any write of location, atmosphere or dispatch text after End Assignment, and spending she had locked herself stays locked.
- (3) #77: the spend count follows the player, so it also carries to a different investigator of the same player.
- (4) The em dash kept in "The Lightkeeper rolled —".
- (5) #86's known live gap: a player's secret roll does not clear the stamp until she reloads.
- (6) The join toast drops Reject; it sits behind View on the Requests page.
- (7) 88.12 clamps a raise past 12 rather than refusing it (a triage call).

There are no AI model names in files (commit trailers aside), no "GM" on screen, and new controls are 44px on touch. The only em dash in added lines is the kept roll-line one.

issues.problem: The player's Circle Resources i reads refillRule, which now already ends 'End Assignment closes it until the next assignment's dispatch and starts the count again.' (charter repair, circleResources.js), and CircleView appends 'Spending closes when an assignment ends and opens again with the next assignment's dispatch.' The same rule is said twice in one slip.
issues.fix: Drop the appended sentence in CircleView.jsx:954 and pass refillRule(...) alone, as CirclePage.jsx:742 does.

issues.problem: spendRefusal stays in the store, and CircleView mounts only while the Circle tab is open (MainDeskView.jsx:298). The effect on [spendRefusal] runs again on each mount, so an old refusal ('Spending is closed until the next assignment starts.') comes back as role=alert for 8 seconds every time the player returns to the tab, even after spending has reopened.
issues.fix: Show it only when Date.now() - spendRefusal.at < 8000 (spendRefusal.at is already stored), or clear spendRefusal in the store once it has been shown or when a circle_update reports resources_editable true.

issues.item: #82 choice: an investigator outside a campaign cannot be revived
issues.problem: The refusal applies to every player socket, unaffiliated ones included. An unaffiliated investigator incapacitated by a fourth mark has no Lightkeeper, and Edit sheet cannot clear incapacitated, so it stays down until it joins a campaign. Decision 4 as written allows this; the death group named it in its merge notes.
issues.fix: Ask Robert: keep it, or let a player socket revive an investigator that is in no campaign (ctx.camp_id is None).

issues.problem: The session has autoflush=False (vtt/db.py:39), so _circle_at_death locks the circle FOR UPDATE before the character's death UPDATE is flushed. release_member locks the character FOR UPDATE first and then the circle (campaigns.py:378-382). A release of the same member at the same moment their fourth scar is recorded can deadlock; PostgreSQL aborts one side, which ends that socket or returns a 500.
issues.fix: Call ctx.db.flush() before the circle query in _circle_at_death, so the character row is locked first, as in release_member. The flush after the lock can stay for resource_pool.

issues.problem: While End Assignment has closed spending, the player's head label still reads 'Spending locked'. The line under it and the Lightkeeper's page ('Closed until the dispatch') say closed.
issues.fix: Use the same spending_paused branch as CirclePage.jsx:684 ('Closed until the dispatch').

issues.item: #79 after a restart the Non-Combatant card goes with no word
issues.problem: Issue #79 asked that the card's refusal be shown the way 'PREMONITIONS NOT USED' is shown. On HEAD the card is dropped silently when the socket reopens after a restart (screenshot 79_head_laptop_restart_2_restart.png: no card, no note). 'Non-Combatant not used' appears only when a pick is refused, and a restart cannot produce that, because the card is dropped before it can be answered. The implementer's note says 'refusal shown'; I did not see it. The silent drop matches how Premonitions behaves and decisions_fix6 1, so this is a gap in the item's wording rather than a break of a decision. I did not get a refusal to show in a browser: my attempt used a second socket, which took the tab over.
issues.fix: Optional. When a socket opens and drops a Non-Combatant card, set interceptRefused to {ability: 'Non-Combatant', detail: 'The server restarted, so that drive point is gone.'} so the card's place says so. Or say plainly in FAQ.md that the card just goes after a restart.
